motions.description: Approve all items on the Consent Agenda, including minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, and various resolutions and ordinances.
Receive and File the recommendation of approval from the Plan, Zoning and Development Commission for the facade Application submitted by Wiklanski's Bakery at 7717-19 W Belmont Ave.
Approve a Resolution Authorizing the Execution of a Facade Improvement Program Agreement between the Village of Elmwood Park and Waclaw Wiklanski.
